_comment: Frontier-MOVEMENT sources for the evolution loop (argo_evolve): releases and announcements about Argo's own stack (models, SDKs, MCP), not project signals (those live in feeds.json). fetch_signals.load_frontier_feeds() loads this. Add a feed by appending {label, url} -- Argo can propose this via a Contents-only PR. GitHub releases always expose an Atom feed at .../releases.atom; the platform.claude.com release-notes page has no feed (a scraper for it is itself a future evolution lever).
